description: mod-consortia-keycloak configuration template. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-consortia-keycloak revision 17); see ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-consortia-keycloak container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-consortia-keycloak container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-consortia-keycloak container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size. Set above the 512m used by comparable keycloak modules to leave headroom for consortium-wide fan-out: sharing settings, roles and policies are published to every member tenant, so request and response collections for all tenants are held in memory at once

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size. Higher than the 256m used by comparable keycloak modules because Hibernate generates entity proxy and enhancement classes at runtime through Byte Buddy, so metaspace demand is not bounded by the static class count. Metaspace is committed lazily, so a higher cap costs nothing unless it is used

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Initial Java metaspace size, i.e. the threshold at which the first metaspace garbage collection is triggered rather than a limit. Set close to the expected steady-state usage to avoid premature full collections during startup

deployment.description: mod-consortia-keycloak keeps all consortium state (consortia, tenants, tenant setup status, user tenant associations, publication records and sharing records) in PostgreSQL, so replicas can run side by side behind a load balancer. All Kafka listeners (USER_CREATED, USER_UPDATED, USER_DELETED, CONSORTIUM_INSTANCE_SHARING_COMPLETE) share a single consumer group per environment, so each event is processed by exactly one replica. The only in-memory state is the modUsersModuleIds Caffeine cache, which is local to each replica and expires 30 seconds after write. The /publications-cleanup timer is invoked externally by mod-scheduler and therefore runs on a single replica per invocation. Two replicas are recommended for availability.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient. Long-running consortium operations are asynchronous: tenant setup and sharing requests return as soon as the publication or setup job is recorded, and callers poll for status rather than holding the connection open.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database host

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database username (sourced from the secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database password (sourced from the secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name holding the mod-consortia-keycloak schema

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum HikariCP connection pool size. Raised above the HikariCP default of 10 so that concurrent HTTP request handling and the async executor (sharing and publication fan-out; up to 2 x CPU threads) do not stall waiting for connections

EnvVars.name: DB_MINSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Minimum number of idle connections HikariCP keeps in the pool (minimumIdle). When unset, folio-spring-base applies its own default of 0, so idle connections are closed after DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: HikariCP idle timeout in milliseconds: how long a connection above DB_MINSHAREDPOOLSIZE may sit idle before it is closed. When unset, folio-spring-base applies its own default of 60000

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime of a pooled connection in milliseconds

EnvVars.name: DB_QUERYTIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL statement_timeout in milliseconds, applied as connection initialization SQL (SET statement_timeout). folio-spring-base has no default: when unset, no statement timeout is applied

EnvVars.name: DB_CHARSET
EnvVars.description: Character encoding used for database connections

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host. Used to consume user lifecycle events and instance sharing completion events

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Security protocol used to communicate with Kafka brokers (PLAINTEXT or SSL)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the Kafka client key store. Applies when KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL requires SSL client authentication

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Kafka client key store

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the Kafka client trust store. Applies when KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL is SSL

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Kafka client trust store

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_EVENTS_CONSUMER_PATTERN
EnvVars.description: Overrides the topic pattern of the USER_CREATED, USER_UPDATED, USER_DELETED and CONSORTIUM_INSTANCE_SHARING_COMPLETE listeners. A single value replaces all four patterns at once, so every listener would subscribe to the same topics; leave unset. When unset, each listener's pattern is derived from ENV and its event type

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_EVENTS_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for each user and instance sharing event listener

EnvVars.name: NUMBER_OF_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions used for topics created by this module

EnvVars.name: REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor used for topics created by this module

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: Enables tenant collection topics (read by folio-service-tools KafkaUtils). When set, the tenant segment of the topics this module creates and produces to is replaced by this qualifier ({ENV}.Default.{qualifier}.{EVENT} instead of {ENV}.Default.{tenant}.{EVENT}), so all tenants share one topic per event type. Must match [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,30} or the module fails to start, and must be set consistently across all modules of the deployment. Value taken from bugfest; when unset, per-tenant topics are used

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Legacy switch of the deprecated folio-spring-system-user library. Must stay false: system users and cross-tenant egress tokens are handled by folio-module-sidecar, and the module only builds a tenant-scoped execution context. Planned for removal together with the library

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_NAME
EnvVars.description: Not used while SYSTEM_USER_ENABLED is false (the module's system user is managed by folio-module-sidecar). Kept only because the deprecated folio-spring-system-user library binds it; planned for removal together with the library. Value taken from bugfest; module default is consortia-system-user

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Not used for authentication while SYSTEM_USER_ENABLED is false, but still required: the deprecated folio-spring-system-user library validates it as non-empty at startup, so the module fails to start without it. Any non-empty value from the secret store works; planned for removal together with the library

EnvVars.name: SINGLE_TENANT_UX
EnvVars.description: Enables single tenant UX, in which member tenant realms authenticate through a Keycloak identity provider pointing at the central tenant realm. Value taken from bugfest; module default is false

EnvVars.name: KC_URL
EnvVars.description: Keycloak base URL used to perform Keycloak Admin API requests

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak admin client ID used for issuing admin tokens. Its secret is read from the secure store, not from an environment variable

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_GRANT_TYPE
EnvVars.description: OAuth2 grant type used to obtain the Keycloak admin token

EnvVars.name: KC_LOGIN_CLIENT_SUFFIX
EnvVars.description: Client name suffix appended to the tenant name when resolving the Keycloak login client that owns the authorization resources. Must match the login client naming used elsewhere in the deployment. Value taken from bugfest; module default is -login-application

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables TLS for the Keycloak Admin API client

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Truststore file path for the Keycloak Admin API client. Required when KC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Truststore password for the Keycloak Admin API client

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore file type for the Keycloak Admin API client (e.g. JKS, PKCS12)

EnvVars.name: KC_IDENTITY_PROVIDER_BASE_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL used to build member tenant identity provider URLs. Defaults to KC_URL. Applies when SINGLE_TENANT_UX is true

EnvVars.name: KC_IDENTITY_PROVIDER_SUFFIX
EnvVars.description: Identity provider alias suffix. Applies when SINGLE_TENANT_UX is true

EnvVars.name: KC_IDENTITY_PROVIDER_DISPLAY_SUFFIX
EnvVars.description: Identity provider display name suffix. Applies when SINGLE_TENANT_UX is true

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name, used as the Kafka topic prefix and as the default first segment of the secure store key; must match the value used by the other modules

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL (the module's sidecar) used to perform HTTP requests to other FOLIO modules

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: HTTP port the module listens on. Must match the port in the sidecar's MODULE_URL

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the mod-consortia-keycloak process (heap sizing, GC, agent flags, etc.). This is the variable honoured by the run-java.sh entrypoint of the folioci/alpine-jre-openjdk21 base image

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Location of an external Log4j2 configuration file, overriding the log4j2.properties bundled with the module

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_REQUEST_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables logging of incoming requests. Intended for troubleshooting only; adds a log record per request

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_REQUEST_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Detail level for incoming request logging (NONE, BASIC, HEADERS, FULL). Applies when FOLIO_LOGGING_REQUEST_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_EXCHANGE_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables logging of outgoing HTTP exchanges to other modules. Intended for troubleshooting only; consortium fan-out produces one exchange per member tenant

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_EXCHANGE_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Detail level for outgoing exchange logging (NONE, BASIC, HEADERS, FULL). Applies when FOLIO_LOGGING_EXCHANGE_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Secure store backend holding the Keycloak admin client secret and the system user password. Supported values: EPHEMERAL, AWS_SSM, VAULT

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE_ENV
EnvVars.description: First segment of the secure store key, for example prod or test. Defaults to the value of ENV, with fallback to 'folio'

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region of the SSM client. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM; when unset the AWS default region provider chain is used

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: Use the IAM role of the running task for SSM authorization instead of explicit credentials. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT
EnvVars.description: The HTTP endpoint used to retrieve AWS credentials. Ignored when SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM is true

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path component of the credentials endpoint URI, appended to SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TOKEN
EnvVars.description: Token for accessing Vault, may be a root token. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Address of the Vault instance. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to Vault

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_PEM_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to an X.509 certificate in unencrypted PEM format (UTF-8), used for Vault SSL verification

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password used to access the Vault client JKS keystore

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to a JKS keystore file containing a Vault client cert and private key

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to a JKS truststore file containing trusted Vault server certs

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier. Must match the module's ENV

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the sidecar process

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-consortia-keycloak container is reachable from its sidecar. The port must match the module's SERVER_PORT

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-consortia-keycloak module deployed alongside this sidecar

EnvVars.name: ALLOW_CROSS_TENANT_REQUESTS
EnvVars.description: Allows requests whose tenant differs from the tenant in the token. Must be enabled for consortium deployments, because mod-consortia-keycloak performs sharing and publication fan-out to member tenants on behalf of a central tenant user
